pairs: When troubled, I cried out to the Lord,
libera animam meam a labiis iniquis et a lingua dolosa.
free my soul from lips of iniquity and from the deceitful tongue.
What will be given to you,
aut quid apponatur tibi ad linguam dolosam?
or what will be added to you, for a deceitful tongue?:
the sharp arrows of the powerful,
along with the burning coals of desolation.
for my sojourning has been prolonged.
I have lived with the inhabitants of Kedar.
My soul has long been a sojourner.
Cum his qui oderunt pacem eram pacificus;
With those who hated peace, I was peaceful.
they fought against me without cause.
